name: ComposedModal

props.name: containerClassName
props.description: Specify an optional className to be applied to the modal node

props.name: danger
props.description: Specify whether the primary button should be replaced with danger button. Note that this prop is not applied if you render primary/danger button by yourself

props.name: decorator
props.description: **Experimental**: Provide a `decorator` component to be rendered inside the `ComposedModal` component

props.name: isFullWidth
props.description: Specify whether the Modal content should have any inner padding.

props.name: launcherButtonRef
props.description: Provide a ref to return focus to once the modal is closed.

props.name: open
props.description: Called for all `onKeyDown` events that do not close the modal / onKeyDown?(evt: KeyboardEvent): void; /** Specify whether the Modal is currently open

props.name: selectorPrimaryFocus
props.description: Specify a CSS selector that matches the DOM element that should be focused when the Modal opens

props.name: selectorsFloatingMenus
props.description: Specify the CSS selectors that match the floating menus.

props.name: slug
props.description: **Experimental**: Provide a `Slug` component to be rendered inside the `ComposedModal` component

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon ComposedModal rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
